biography.plain_text: Judy Volta is an American software engineer who co-founded V-Technologies with Angelo Volta after college. The pair built the Connecticut company for three decades, developing software that connected business systems with parcel and freight carriers. Aptean acquired the enterprise in 2021, concluding the founders' ownership of the platform they had created.

confidence.reason: A direct founder testimonial establishes the after-college start, engineering background and three-decade development period. Aptean's release independently identifies Judy as co-founder, describes the software's function and confirms the 2021 acquisition.

long_biography.plain_text:
Preparing V-Technologies for sale, Judy and Angelo Volta said their engineering backgrounds made them value precise expectations, methodical due diligence and rigorous analysis. Their account also makes the division of responsibility clear: Judy was publicly presented as a co-founder, whereas Angelo held the chief-executive title.

The firm's StarShip and ShipGear products automated rate selection, dispatch and tracking across parcel and palletised-freight workflows. They integrated order data from ERP and ecommerce applications with logistics networks, reducing manual handoffs between the front office and fulfilment. The buyer, Aptean, retained these products and partner relationships after the 2021 transaction.
